# Golden fixtures

These files hold the output of crate-labels' own encoders, plus a few protocol vectors
and inputs written by hand. The tests compare what the code produces with them, so a
diff shows exactly what changed on the wire or on the page. After an intended change,
check the diff and regenerate:

```sh
go test ./internal/raster ./internal/driver/phomemo ./internal/heatshrink \
        ./internal/driver/munbyn ./internal/driver/clabel \
        ./internal/ipp ./internal/driver/ipp ./internal/sheets -update
```

Label renders have their own snapshots in `testdata/layout-reference/`
(`go test ./internal/layout -update`).

Many tests also check outputs against their definitions rather than taking the snapshot
on trust. For example, compressed payloads are decoded back, dithering preserves mean
grey, and job splits never exceed the printer's row limit.

## raster/

- `cases.json` lists each placement case: the design size, rotation, head width, lane,
  row limit and expected image box.
- `<case>.bin` holds the packed rows that `raster.Render` produces for it.
- Inputs are drawn by the test.
- Packed rows run top to bottom, `ceil(width/8)` bytes per row, MSB is the leftmost dot,
  1 means black.

## phomemo/

One case per model and stock, plus cases for the settings (rotation, offset, paper
alignment, speed and darkness, block size, a label wider than the head):

- `<case>.json`: the case's parameters;
- `<case>.job0.bin`: the complete printer job (header, raster blocks, footer);
- `<case>.preview.pgm`: the dots as an 8-bit gray P5 image (255 = white).

The input is a generated test card.

## heatshrink/, munbyn/, clabel/

Most of these files are generated by crate-labels' own Go code. To regenerate them, run:

    go test ./internal/heatshrink/ -update
    go test ./internal/driver/munbyn/ ./internal/driver/clabel/ -update

Generated files are snapshots: a diff shows what changed on the wire. The tests do not
take them on trust; they also check each output from its definition (see below).

Some files are written by hand and are never regenerated:
- the protocol vectors in `munbyn/codec.json`, `clabel/codec.json` and `*/frames/*.bin`;
- the corpus inputs `heatshrink/*.in.bin` and every `input.png`;
- the `what`, `model`, `stock` and `settings` fields of each manifest.

Formats:
- `*.bin` files hold raw bytes.
- PNGs are lossless 8-bit gray.
- JSON hex is lowercase, without spaces.
- In `munbyn/codec.json` `decode_fields`, a JSON number is a varint field and a string is
  a length-delimited field (hex).

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `heatshrink/manifest.json` | Stream parameters (11/4, shortest reference 3) and the corpus list: input, encoded snapshot, sizes. Also two decoder-only vectors. |
| `heatshrink/*.in.bin` | Corpus inputs: edge cases, random data, and eight 3840-byte rows of a dithered 50x80 label. |
| `heatshrink/*.hs.bin` | `heatshrink.Encode` output for each input. The tests also decode each file with the ported library decoder at several buffer sizes. They check every back-reference against the token rules, and check optimality against an exhaustive search on small inputs. |
| `munbyn/codec.json` | Protocol vectors: frames, varints, zigzag and payload builder. How replies are read: reassembler cases, reply kinds, the problem condition for each status, rows per section. |
| `munbyn/frames/*.bin` | The fixed command frames: DEVICE_INFO, PRINT_END and PAPER_TYPE_SET (gap, continuous, black mark). |
| `munbyn/jobs/*/manifest.json` | The job's inputs, plus a snapshot of its layout, sizes and per-section compressed and package counts. |
| `munbyn/jobs/*/raster.bin` | The packed head-width raster. In `worked-8x2` it is the input. |
| `munbyn/jobs/*/all-packages.bin` | Every DEVICE_PRINT frame, in send order. The tests also check each package's frame and field layout, and that each section decodes back to its raster rows. |
| `munbyn/jobs/*/{input,preview}.png` | The design (input) and the driver preview: the content box, 0 = burn. |
| `clabel/codec.json` | Protocol vectors: CRC-8/SMBUS, control frames, TSPL tenths, print time per page. How replies are read: reply kinds and reassembler cases. |
| `clabel/frames/*.bin` | The fixed control frames: identity query, setting reads and writes. |
| `clabel/jobs/<model>/<stock>/manifest.json` | The job's inputs, plus a snapshot of its canvas, layout, rated dpi and pages: rows, paper, print time. |
| `clabel/jobs/*/page-NN.txt` | Each page's TSPL text. DEFLATE payloads and their lengths are elided, because those bytes depend on the DEFLATE encoder. |
| `clabel/jobs/*/page-NN-raster.bin` | A page's packed rows, which its bands must inflate to. |
| `clabel/jobs/*/{input,preview}.png` | As for munbyn. |

## ipp/, sheets/

IPP requests, URF encoder cases, the decoded attributes of a real printer (a Brother
HL-L3290CDW, with its address and identifiers replaced by documentation values), and
sheet-imposition geometry. [ipp/README.md](ipp/README.md) lists the files and what each
one pins down.
